parameter_treatment.source_base: 10m path, 3m flow-channel width, 0.6mm channel aperture, 400mL/min, k=5 W/m/K, rock rho=2500, cp=790, water cp=4460 from Fu2020. Local JT coefficient from Zhang2018.
parameter_treatment.mixing_of_source_models: A reduced rectangular flow channel is used. This is not the source's full 3D fracture network; source parameters are not fitted measurements of this reduction.
parameter_treatment.no_field_fit: GDR circulation data were not obtained. No validation error against field data is available.

causal_model.thermal: Advection in a fixed-aperture channel with two semi-infinite conductive rock half spaces; analytical Laplace transfer exp(-a sqrt(s)-delay*s). Independently checked by implicit fluid/rock finite volumes.
causal_model.pressure: A local downstream isenthalpic pressure drop adds beta*0.2176*pressure_drop to outlet temperature; beta is a nuisance parameter. Does not assume entire injection-production pressure difference is that drop.

conventional_full_model_comparison.within_reduced_physics: Ordinary coupled thermal/JT modelling uses exactly the same thermal transfer and nuisance model as candidate.
conventional_full_model_comparison.external_3D_strong_baseline: Wu2021/TOUGH/STOMP full-field model is NOT reproduced. It remains an unexecuted strong comparator, so no useful-service superiority is established.

executed_criticism.defect: Raw response separation can be a pressure/calibration signature and is not sufficient thermal identifiability.

typed_constraint.requirement: Score differences only after eliminating the prospectively allowed local pressure response, constant offset and linear drift; refuse when nuisance spans thermal response.

executed_criticism.interpretation: The expanded-nuisance witness is deliberately adversarial, not empirical; it proves identifiability is conditional on a defensible nuisance class. Free-form drift destroys the guarantee.

design_search.grammar: Six sequential8day inlet-temperature interventions, each28C or11.5C, followed by30C return; all64 sequences executed under the same forward model.
design_search.insight_provenance: Assistant-authored transfer of nuisance annihilation/lock-in logic to known geothermal JT confounding. Sequence search is executed; governing physics and grammar are developer-supplied.
constraints: same temperature levels for all arms
no live pump or sensor commands

calibration.scope: Independent numerical discretization check of the reduced equations, not field calibration.
calibration.source_consistency: Fu2020 reports a very small early thermal signal obscured by several-degree JT effects; the source does not supply a scalar24day ground truth for this rectangular reduction.

verdict.physical_next_step: Obtain local pressure, temperature, mixing and calibration data; qualify forward model and actual controls before prescribing or claiming a thermal result.
